corrections.title: Replace 3v3 The Stranger BANE note with concise copy after the #171 append became unwieldy
corrections.rationale: Owner dictates exact replacement copy in issue #180: the C2 reliability warning appended by CR-2026-11-10-171-P01 made the mobile in-app note unwieldy. This correction replaces the entire BANE notes field for the exact 3v3 The Stranger defence with the owner's single approved paragraph; tier C, bannerScore 48, undersize 1 and non-provisional status are unchanged. This is a replacement, not an append.
